integrity: The proof independently derives the spectral-endpoint defect constants and uses the cited paper only for the intrinsic-part criterion and metric formula. Finite-dimensional numerical checks were sanity checks, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real Hilbertian renormings; no claim for arbitrary equivalent norms.
No geodesic or curvature description is asserted.
The focal preprint is recent, so an unindexed equivalent formulation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Equivalent Hilbert norms have intrinsic distance exactly three times the log distance
